fields.description: LiteLLM provider name, e.g. openai, anthropic, openrouter, gemini, cloudflare. Any Flow Model whose Model ID starts with this provider uses these credentials unless it sets its own (Cloudflare models always use these).
fields.label: Provider

fields.description: API key for this provider. Leave empty for local servers (Ollama, LM Studio) that don't require authentication. For Cloudflare this is the API token.
fields.label: API Key

fields.description: Optional. Override the provider's default endpoint, e.g. a proxy or self-hosted gateway. For Cloudflare this is the full OpenAI-compatible root (https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/<account>/ai/v1), derived from the Account ID when empty.
fields.label: Base URL

fields.description: Your Cloudflare account id: 32 hexadecimal characters, shown on the account home page in the dashboard.
fields.label: Account ID

fields.description: Optional. The AI Gateway to send requests through, for logging and caching. Leave empty to call Workers AI directly.
fields.label: Gateway ID

fields.description: Optional JSON object of provider-specific kwargs merged into every call (e.g. {"api_version": "2024-02-01"} for Azure). A model's own params take precedence.
fields.label: Extra Params
